description: Landes : Réseau de distribution de Gaz is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Contains data describing the gas distribution networks (Gascogne Energie Service). Only a few municipalities in the Landes have a vectorized network. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Landes: Gas distribution network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspire. The listing shows 2010-06-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
